tightening_methods.M-T1: torque-controlled: calibrated setting torque wrench (ISO 6789-1 Type II; tool tolerance per its class, TO-VERIFY at purchase), screws snugged then taken to the final torque in one pass, opposite-pair / cross order on multi-screw patterns; threads clean, lubrication state as on the drawing (the K basis); N2O-system joints: oxygen-compatible PFPE grease only
tightening_methods.M-T2: as M-T1 with a calibrated setting torque screwdriver (ISO 6789-1 Type II) for final torques below 1 N m
tightening_methods.M-T1L: as M-T1 (M-T2 tool below 1 N m) on threads coated with the thread locker of the line (cure per the maker sheet before load); torque applied on the wet locker
tightening_methods.M-T1Ti: as M-T1; torque from a torque-tension test of the anodised (AMS 2488 Type 2) + PFPE-lubricated Ti screw (K TO-VERIFY); the v3.5.1 A4-70 torque shown until that test
tightening_methods.M-NONE: not a torque joint (dowel, insert, seal, washer, clip, consumable)
tightening_methods.M-T1J: J-FWD (HW-101, lead 17:55:55Z F1 / F2, 16:53Z R3): as M-T1L (wet thread locker of the line, cure per the maker sheet before load) with the final torque SET PER FLIGHT LOT by J-F1: T_lot = 3750 N x K_min(lot) x 5 mm, so that the lot's K_min gives <= 3750 N (today's K window 0.1465-0.267: 2.747 N m, minimum 2057.6 N at K 0.267); the disc spring HW-170 under each head; C4 registration (lead 17:55:55Z F2): two GSE shoulder screws ENG-TC-13 (not flight), selected to the pin-gauged TC-01 holes, go into two opposite holes before any flight screw; the flight screws are fitted one at a time, each taken to the lot torque and recorded (hole number, screw and spring lot, torque, wrench); the two shoulder screws come out last and are replaced by flight screws, recorded; never re-torqued (single-use, R3)
